    Weight lifting for the ray table of A₀ #

    Proposition 8.3(3) for P = ray A₀ ("For the present P = ray A₀, freeness already follows directly from Proposition 7.2"): an additive weight of P modulo two factors through W(P) ⊗ 𝔽₂; since W(P) is free (WP_free), it lifts to an integer additive weight (A0Mult_lift2).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
